title: 埃克塞特本科卓越獎：合格學年學費各減15,000英鎊
Exeter Excellence undergraduate award: £15,000 off each eligible tuition year
description: 2027年9月本科直接入學的台灣自費海外生可競爭申請；須先持錄取，第一輪2027年3月4日截止，校內ISC銜接與指定課程排除。

Eligible self-funded Taiwanese international students entering year one directly in September 2027 may apply after receiving an offer. Round one closes on 4 March 2027; ISC progression and specified courses are excluded.
funding: 合格全額學費學年各減£15,000；非生活費
£15,000 tuition discount in each eligible full-fee year; no living allowance

sources.label: Exeter｜2027/28本科卓越獎官方申請頁
SA Global｜2027本科獎獨立申請整理

paragraphs: ## 補助能減少多少費用
## What the award covers
Exeter Excellence Scholarships 2027/28本科方案提供150個名額，每個合格、繳交全額學費的學年減免15,000英鎊。這是學費折抵，不是現金或生活津貼；海外交換、實習及重讀等非合格學年不適用。獲獎仍須符合持續領取條件，不能把整個學位的所有年份一律乘上獎額。

The Exeter Excellence undergraduate scheme for 2027/28 offers 150 awards, each reducing tuition by £15,000 in an eligible full-fee year. It is a fee discount rather than cash or a living allowance. Study-abroad, placement, repeat and other ineligible years are excluded. Continued eligibility matters; do not simply multiply the amount by every year of a degree.
## 台灣學生需符合的入學路徑
## The eligible route for Taiwanese applicants
申請者須為自費、國際學費身分，已持2027年9月合格本科一年級的有條件或無條件錄取，學術表現預期至少相當於A-level AAB。獎項沒有排除台灣國籍，但並非所有台灣高中畢業生都能直接入學；校方台灣指引通常要求適當預科或其他認可銜接學歷，部分高中加大學一年等資格可個別審查。

Applicants must be self-funded, assessed at international fees and hold a conditional or unconditional offer for an eligible first-year undergraduate course starting in September 2027. Academic performance is expected to be at least equivalent to A-level AAB. Taiwanese nationality is not excluded, but a Taiwanese high-school diploma alone does not automatically permit direct entry. Exeter's Taiwan guidance normally requires suitable foundation or other recognised preparation, with some high-school-plus-university qualifications considered individually.
特別注意：Exeter International Study Centre銜接學生不符合這個獎項，即使能循該管道進入大學，也不代表可領此獎。醫學BMBS、醫學影像、CUHK雙聯LLB/JD、Brickfields銜接LLB及學位學徒制等排除。把Exeter列為Insurance choice也不符合領獎安排；須逐一對照課程與完整條款。

Exeter International Study Centre progression students are excluded from this award, even where that route leads to university admission. Exclusions also include BMBS Medicine, Medical Imaging, the CUHK dual LLB/JD, Brickfields LLB progression and degree apprenticeships. Holding Exeter as an insurance choice does not meet the award arrangements. Check the exact course and full terms.
## 先取得錄取，再另外申請
## Receive an offer, then submit a separate application
第一輪已於2026年9月28日開放，2027年3月4日截止；官方頁列時刻為11:59 GMT，本頁依原文保留，不改寫成23:59。申請表含兩題各最多150字的個人陳述，需具體說明個人目標與對校園的貢獻。通常不得與其他Exeter獎學金合併，延期或改修不合格課程可能使獎項失效。

Round one opened on 28 September 2026 and closes on 4 March 2027. The official page states 11:59 GMT; we retain that wording rather than changing it to 23:59. A separate form includes two personal-statement questions of up to 150 words each about aspirations and contribution. Other Exeter awards generally cannot be combined, and deferral or transfer to an ineligible programme may invalidate the award.
## 查核與預算提醒
## Verification and budgeting
2026年11月15日實讀校方申請頁、完整條款及台灣學歷指引，並交叉檢視SA Global的申請整理。金額與資格以校方條款為準；顧問整理不代表校方或保證錄取。請另備未獲獎時的學費、住宿與生活預算。這是今日新收錄的本科競爭型方案，與雷達既有Exeter台灣研究所地區獎不同。

On 15 November 2026 we read the official application page, full terms and Taiwan entry guidance and cross-checked SA Global's application guide. Official terms govern; an adviser guide is neither the university nor an admission guarantee. Budget for tuition, housing and living costs without assuming an award. This newly listed competitive undergraduate scheme differs from the existing Exeter Taiwan postgraduate regional award.

title: 埃克塞特碩士卓越獎：2027年9月入學首年學費減15,000英鎊
Exeter Excellence master's award: £15,000 off first-year fees for September 2027
description: 台灣自費海外生持合格授課型碩士錄取可申請；第一輪2027年1月28日截止，非全額生活資助，不與校內其他獎項併領。

Self-funded Taiwanese international offer holders for eligible taught master's courses may apply. Round one closes on 28 January 2027. This is not living-cost funding and cannot be combined with other Exeter scholarships.
deadline: 第一輪2027年1月28日；請提早送出並向校方確認截止時刻
Round one: 28 January 2027; submit early and confirm the closing time with Exeter
paragraphs: ## 首年減免，不是全額獎學金
## A first-year discount, not a full scholarship
Exeter Excellence Scholarships 2027/28授課型碩士方案有150個名額，首年國際學費減免15,000英鎊，後續學年不續發，不含住宿、生活費或旅費。它與既有台灣地區獎是不同競爭型方案，但校方明訂不能和其他Exeter獎學金合併；比較時應比較可實際領取的單一方案，不能把金額相加。

The Exeter Excellence taught master's scheme for 2027/28 offers 150 awards of £15,000 against first-year international tuition. It does not renew or cover accommodation, living costs or travel. This competitive scheme differs from the Taiwan regional award, but Exeter prohibits combining it with other university scholarships. Compare the award actually available rather than adding advertised amounts together.
## 台灣資格與課程排除
## Taiwan eligibility and course exclusions
須為自費國際學費身分，已持2027年9月合格授課型碩士錄取，學術表現達英國2:1同等程度。校方台灣頁列認可大學學位的2:1參考門檻為70%、GPA 2.8/4或3.0/4.3；實際仍依科系、學歷審查與英語要求，符合最低值不保證錄取或獲獎。

Applicants must be self-funded, pay international fees, hold an eligible September 2027 taught master's offer and demonstrate UK 2:1-equivalent achievement. Exeter's Taiwan guidance gives reference equivalents of 70%, GPA 2.8/4 or 3.0/4.3 from recognised universities. Course-specific requirements, qualification assessment and English requirements still apply; meeting a reference threshold guarantees neither admission nor funding.
限英國校區合格課程，完全線上與遠距課程排除；One Planet MBA、經濟學MRes、Finance博士銜接MRes、Island Biodiversity and Conservation碩士、CEDAR臨床心理課程及指定法律、雙聯、文憑與學徒制課程等也不適用。申請前須在官方完整排除清單核對自己的正式課名，不以學院名稱推定全部合格。

Only eligible UK campus-based courses qualify. Fully online and distance courses are excluded, as are the One Planet MBA, MRes Economics, the Finance MRes PhD pathway, Island Biodiversity and Conservation, CEDAR clinical psychology and specified law, dual-degree, diploma and apprenticeship courses. Check your exact course against the full official exclusions rather than assuming every course in a faculty is eligible.
## 日期已核對，截止時刻請勿自行換算
## Verified date; do not infer the closing time
第一輪2026年9月28日開放，2027年1月28日截止，預計2月25日前通知結果。官方網頁把時刻寫作「II:59 GMT」，完整條款僅列日期；本頁不替校方猜測這個排字的意思，也不換算成台灣午夜。請提前完成，若需要壓線規劃，先向官方獎學金窗口取得時刻確認。

Round one opened on 28 September 2026, closes on 28 January 2027 and expects decisions by 25 February. The official webpage prints the time as 'II:59 GMT', while the terms give only the date. We do not infer what that typography means or convert it into a Taiwan midnight deadline. Submit ahead of time and obtain confirmation from Exeter if an exact closing time is essential to your planning.
取得課程錄取後，另填獎學金表格及兩題各最多150字的個人陳述；須展現本人經驗、目標與校園貢獻，不把通用AI稿當成個人經歷。11月15日核對官方條款與Scholarships Central外部整理；本頁僅計一次2027/28碩士方案，不把不同申請輪次拆成多個新增獎項。

After receiving a course offer, submit the separate scholarship form and two personal statements of up to 150 words each. Describe your own experience, goals and contribution rather than presenting generic AI text as personal history. On 15 November we checked the official terms and Scholarships Central's external guide. The 2027/28 master's scheme is counted once, not split into multiple new awards by application round.

title: 教育部與劍橋博士獎：台灣申請者須同步完成兩邊申請
Taiwan–Cambridge PhD scholarship: complete both the Taiwan and Cambridge applications
description: 2027/28全時博士約5名，資助學費與生活等費用；教育部116年聯合甄選2026年12月2日中午截止，另須遵守劍橋課程資助期限。

Around five full-time PhD awards for 2027/28 cover fees, maintenance and other costs. Taiwan's 116-year joint selection closes at noon on 2 December 2026; Cambridge course funding deadlines also apply.
funding: 學費、生活費、簽證與健保附加費等；依核定條件
Fees, maintenance, visa and immigration health costs, subject to award terms
deadline: 教育部2026年12月2日12:00台北時間；另守劍橋課程資助期限
MOE: 2 December 2026, 12:00 Taipei time; Cambridge course funding deadline also applies

sources.label: 教育部｜116年世界百大合作獎學金公告
教育部｜116年聯合甄選申請入口

paragraphs: ## 約五名博士資助，與Gates Cambridge不同
## Around five PhD awards, distinct from Gates Cambridge
Taiwan Cambridge Scholarship針對2027/28全時博士，約提供5個名額。劍橋資助頁列學費、生活費、簽證、英國健保附加費及其他項目，通常涵蓋課程期間，另可依申請提供最多六個月寫作期生活支持。這是教育部與劍橋合作方案，不是Gates Cambridge，也不是只要取得博士錄取就自動獲得。

The Taiwan Cambridge Scholarship offers around five full-time PhD awards for 2027/28. Cambridge lists fees, maintenance, visa costs, the immigration health surcharge and other items for the course period, with up to six further months of writing-up maintenance available on application. This MOE–Cambridge partnership is distinct from Gates Cambridge and is not automatically awarded with admission.
## 國籍、戶籍與既有補助都要檢查
## Check nationality, household registration and existing funding
教育部116年甄選要求具中華民國國籍、在台設有戶籍，符合已畢業或應屆畢業等資格，尚未取得博士學位；既往公費留學、政府補助與雙聯學位等限制須依簡章核對。劍橋另要求海外學費身分及台灣、澎湖、金門、馬祖居住資格；因海外求學暫住外地不因此排除。臨床及加收高額費用的指定學位不適用。

MOE's 116-year selection requires ROC nationality and household registration in Taiwan, qualifying graduation status and no existing PhD. Restrictions concerning prior government-funded study, other public support and joint degrees must be checked in the regulations. Cambridge additionally specifies overseas-fee status and residence in Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen or Matsu; residence abroad for education does not itself exclude a candidate. Clinical and specified premium-fee degrees are excluded.
## 兩邊申請都完成，不能只填一張表
## Both application routes are required
教育部本輪已於2026年11月9日08:30開放，12月2日中午12:00台北時間截止。申請者仍須按劍橋所選課程的資助截止日完成研究所申請，並在資助選項中表達申請此獎意願；兩個系統不能互相取代。12月23日補件期限不是新申請延長，請不要等到補件日才首次送件。

The MOE round opened at 08:30 Taipei time on 9 November 2026 and closes at noon on 2 December. Candidates must also complete their Cambridge graduate application by the relevant course funding deadline and opt into consideration for this award. Neither system replaces the other. The 23 December supplementary-document date is not an extension for new applications.
## 查核說明
## Verification notes
2026年11月15日分別讀取劍橋資助資料與台灣教育部公告，交叉核對兩個申請端的年度、名額與條件。劍橋網址雖以2026結尾，頁面所列資助學年為2027/28；本頁依內容而非網址年份判讀。金額與實際年限依兩方核定，不自行補出未公告固定生活費。雷達原有百大合作方案總覽不等於已列入這個劍橋專屬項目。

On 15 November 2026 we read Cambridge's funding record and Taiwan MOE's notice to cross-check the two application routes, year, places and conditions. Although Cambridge's URL ends in 2026, its listed award year is 2027/28; we use the page content rather than infer the year from the URL. Amounts and duration depend on the award decision, and we do not invent a fixed maintenance amount. The existing general MOE partnership overview is not the same as this Cambridge-specific listing.
